description: Persian claims against English evidence: the claims of 30 pairs from labelled_pairs.json translated into Persian, evidence and labels unchanged.
translator: Claude (AI); not yet reviewed by a person

pairs.claim: BNRM تحلیل عاملی نامنفی را در مدل ترجیح بردلی–تری ادغام می‌کند.
pairs.evidence: We propose Bayesian Non-Negative Reward Model (BNRM), a principled reward modeling framework that integrates non-negative factor analysis into Bradley-Terry (BT) preference model.
pairs.label: supported

pairs.claim: یک شبکهٔ استنتاج وردشی سرشکن‌شده به BNRM امکان می‌دهد تا به مدل‌های زبانی بزرگ امروزی مقیاس یابد.
pairs.evidence: To scale BNRM to modern LLMs, we develop an amortized variational inference network conditioned on deep model representations, allowing efficient end-to-end training.
pairs.label: supported

pairs.claim: BNRM بهینه‌سازی بیش از حد پاداش را به‌طور چشمگیری کاهش می‌دهد.
pairs.evidence: Extensive empirical results demonstrate that BNRM substantially mitigates reward over-optimization, improves robustness under distribution shifts, and yields more interpretable reward decompositions than strong baselines.
pairs.label: supported

pairs.claim: RLHF روش اصلی همسو کردن مدل‌های زبانی بزرگ با ترجیحات انسانی است.
pairs.evidence: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has emerged as the primary method for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences.
pairs.label: supported

pairs.claim: فرایند RLHF معمولاً با آموزش یک مدل پاداش روی داده‌های ترجیح انسانی آغاز می‌شود.
pairs.evidence: The RLHF process typically starts by training a reward model (RM) using human preference data.
pairs.label: supported

pairs.claim: مدل‌های پاداش متعارف روی پاسخ‌های جفتی به یک درخواست یکسان آموزش می‌بینند.
pairs.evidence: Conventional RMs are trained on pairwise responses to the same user request, with relative ratings indicating which response humans prefer.
pairs.label: supported

pairs.claim: خروجی مدل‌های پاداش تفسیرپذیر نیست، چون این مدل‌ها جعبهٔ سیاه‌اند.
pairs.evidence: However, due to the black-box nature of RMs, their outputs lack interpretability, as humans cannot intuitively understand why an RM thinks a response is good or not.
pairs.label: supported

pairs.claim: ArmoRM با Llama-3 8B و یک شبکهٔ دروازه‌ای متشکل از یک MLP کم‌عمق آموزش داده شد.
pairs.evidence: We efficiently trained an ArmoRM with Llama-3 8B and a gating network consisting of a shallow MLP on top of the ArmoRM.
pairs.label: supported

pairs.claim: بازی با مشخصات زمانی رخ می‌دهد که سامانه‌های هوش مصنوعی رفتارهای ناخواسته‌ای را بیاموزند که پاداش بالایی دارند.
pairs.evidence: In reinforcement learning, specification gaming occurs when AI systems learn undesired behaviors that are highly rewarded due to misspecified training goals.
pairs.label: supported

pairs.claim: دستکاری پاداش یعنی مدل مستقیماً سازوکار پاداش خود را تغییر دهد.
pairs.evidence: Specification gaming can range from simple behaviors like sycophancy to sophisticated and pernicious behaviors like reward-tampering, where a model directly modifies its own reward mechanism.
pairs.label: supported

pairs.claim: BNRM مدل ترجیح بردلی–تری را به‌کلی کنار می‌گذارد.
pairs.evidence: We propose Bayesian Non-Negative Reward Model (BNRM), a principled reward modeling framework that integrates non-negative factor analysis into Bradley-Terry (BT) preference model.
pairs.label: contradicted

pairs.claim: BNRM را نمی‌توان به‌صورت سرتاسری آموزش داد.
pairs.evidence: To scale BNRM to modern LLMs, we develop an amortized variational inference network conditioned on deep model representations, allowing efficient end-to-end training.
pairs.label: contradicted

pairs.claim: BNRM بهینه‌سازی بیش از حد پاداش را به‌طور چشمگیری بدتر می‌کند.
pairs.evidence: Extensive empirical results demonstrate that BNRM substantially mitigates reward over-optimization, improves robustness under distribution shifts, and yields more interpretable reward decompositions than strong baselines.
pairs.label: contradicted

pairs.claim: RLHF به‌عنوان روشی برای همسو کردن مدل‌های زبانی بزرگ کنار گذاشته شده است.
pairs.evidence: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has emerged as the primary method for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences.
pairs.label: contradicted

pairs.claim: فرایند RLHF معمولاً بدون هیچ مدل پاداشی آغاز می‌شود.
pairs.evidence: The RLHF process typically starts by training a reward model (RM) using human preference data.
pairs.label: contradicted

pairs.claim: مدل‌های پاداش متعارف فقط روی پاسخ‌های تکی با امتیازهای مطلق آموزش می‌بینند.
pairs.evidence: Conventional RMs are trained on pairwise responses to the same user request, with relative ratings indicating which response humans prefer.
pairs.label: contradicted

pairs.claim: انسان‌ها به‌آسانی می‌فهمند چرا یک مدل پاداش پاسخی را ترجیح می‌دهد.
pairs.evidence: However, due to the black-box nature of RMs, their outputs lack interpretability, as humans cannot intuitively understand why an RM thinks a response is good or not.
pairs.label: contradicted

pairs.claim: ArmoRM با یک مدل ۷۰ میلیارد پارامتری و بدون شبکهٔ دروازه‌ای آموزش داده شد.
pairs.evidence: We efficiently trained an ArmoRM with Llama-3 8B and a gating network consisting of a shallow MLP on top of the ArmoRM.
pairs.label: contradicted

pairs.claim: بازی با مشخصات فقط زمانی رخ می‌دهد که اهداف آموزش کاملاً دقیق مشخص شده باشند.
pairs.evidence: In reinforcement learning, specification gaming occurs when AI systems learn undesired behaviors that are highly rewarded due to misspecified training goals.
pairs.label: contradicted

pairs.claim: آموزش روی محیط‌های آغازین برنامهٔ درسی، بازی با مشخصات را در محیط‌های بعدی از میان می‌برد.
pairs.evidence: We construct a curriculum of increasingly sophisticated gameable environments and find that training on early-curriculum environments leads to more specification gaming on remaining environments.
pairs.label: contradicted

pairs.claim: BNRM روی بیش از یک تریلیون توکن آموزش داده شد.
pairs.evidence: We propose Bayesian Non-Negative Reward Model (BNRM), a principled reward modeling framework that integrates non-negative factor analysis into Bradley-Terry (BT) preference model.
pairs.label: neutral

pairs.claim: BNRM روی پرسش‌وپاسخ پزشکی ارزیابی شد.
pairs.evidence: Extensive empirical results demonstrate that BNRM substantially mitigates reward over-optimization, improves robustness under distribution shifts, and yields more interpretable reward decompositions than strong baselines.
pairs.label: neutral

pairs.claim: آموزش مدل‌های پاداش تفسیرپذیر ارزان‌تر است.
pairs.evidence: However, due to the black-box nature of RMs, their outputs lack interpretability, as humans cannot intuitively understand why an RM thinks a response is good or not.
pairs.label: neutral

pairs.claim: ArmoRM در کمتر از یک ساعت آموزش داده شد.
pairs.evidence: We efficiently trained an ArmoRM with Llama-3 8B and a gating network consisting of a shallow MLP on top of the ArmoRM.
pairs.label: neutral

pairs.claim: چاپلوسی خطرناک‌ترین شکل بازی با مشخصات است.
pairs.evidence: Specification gaming can range from simple behaviors like sycophancy to sophisticated and pernicious behaviors like reward-tampering, where a model directly modifies its own reward mechanism.
pairs.label: neutral

pairs.claim: آموزش بی‌آزاری، چاپلوسی را به نصف کاهش می‌دهد.
pairs.evidence: Moreover, adding harmlessness training to our gameable environments does not prevent reward-tampering.
pairs.label: neutral

pairs.claim: LearningEMS را یک خودروساز توسعه داده است.
pairs.evidence: LearningEMS is distinguished by its ability to support a variety of EV configurations, including hybrid EVs, fuel cell EVs, and plug-in EVs, offering a general platform for the development of EMS.
pairs.label: neutral

pairs.claim: مجموعه‌دادهٔ این چارچوب در اروپا گردآوری شده است.
pairs.evidence: In summary, we offer a unified and comprehensive framework that comes with three distinct EV platforms, over 10 000 km of EMS policy data set, ten state-of-the-art algorithms, and over 160 benchmark tasks, along with three learning libraries.
pairs.label: neutral

pairs.claim: رفتار وسواسی ناشی از یک ژن واحد است.
pairs.evidence: IntroductionCompulsive behavior has been proposed as a transdiagnostic trait observed in different neuropsychiatric disorders, such as obsessive-compulsive disorder, autism, and schizophrenia.
pairs.label: neutral

pairs.claim: بیشتر پاسخ‌دهندگان به دلیل بیماری بازنشسته شدند.
pairs.evidence: METHODS: We included 1735 respondents from the Swedish Longitudinal Occupational Survey of Health (SLOSH), retiring during 2008–2016 (mean retirement age 66 years).
pairs.label: neutral
